name: SIQ - Marquee Wall
description: Mesmerizing infinite-scroll testimonial wall with multiple counter-rotating marquee lanes. Reviews flow in both directions at different speeds, creating a living wall of social proof. Each card features a glassmorphism design, 3D tilt on hover, animated star rating, avatar glow pulse, and a glowing quote accent. Supports 2–4 lanes with independent speed and direction control, pause-on-hover per lane, and smooth acceleration/deceleration. Fully responsive with configurable card sizes, colors, spacing, and over 60 settings. A show-stopping social proof section for premium brands.
author: SectionIQ
